body:
```suggestion
| `use_git_executable` | `false`                                       | Do not use `gitoxide` for computing the status, but use the `git` executable instead.                       |
```

I don't have my Windows system at hand right now, but I assume that Windows will also benefit from the lower thread limit. For other operating systems, this should probably be limited to [8 or `STARSHIP_NUM_THREADS`](https://github.com/starship/starship/blob/master/src/main.rs#L284-L290) like the global thread pool to avoid issues on systems with high core counts.
